scope: Independent inspection of 21 representative frames decoded from the encoded native portrait master.

video.hashMethod: FFmpeg SHA-256 of copied video packets only; excludes audio and container metadata.

findings.result: The aligned IN SYNC word and subsequent broken-word nudge state remain distinct and readable. Track and nudge labels remain inside portrait safe margins.
The encoded spectrogram word is clear. Caption cue text, timing controls, search and waveform are separated without the earlier docking collision.
Catalog search, transcription, QC, proxy zoetrope and aligned timecode layouts have legible labels and no sampled clipping or overlap. Waveforms stay inside their clip bounds.
Director energy bars, explanation and cut strip are separated. Cut list, recipe stages and caption styles remain legible and within the portrait layout.
Approve/reject, optional API, selected changes and local queue states remain explicit. Human review and local-calibration wording is visible without collisions.
Arabic glyphs are joined and RTL controls fit their panels. The timeline and timecode remain LTR; source labels and privacy rows remain contained.
The intentionally miniature chapter mosaic, centered wordmark and final call to action decode correctly. The mosaic serves as a recap; its thumbnail text is not treated as feature-reading acceptance.

limitations: Sampled frames only: this is not continuous viewing or proof that every frame is free of defects.
No continuous listening, audio-mix acceptance or audiovisual synchronization claim.
No physical-phone, native-device playback performance or user aesthetic acceptance claim.
This receipt remains applicable after audio-only remuxing only if the encoded video packet hash is unchanged.
